description: Ministry of Roads and Highways  - Southern Highway (Kottawa- Mattala) as National Highways under National Thoroughfares Act
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the exercise of regulatory powers under the National Thoroughfares Act, No. 40 of 2008. It contains a legal order revoking previous gazette notifications and declaring specific roads as National Highways, which constitutes regulatory action under existing legislation. While a minister is named, this is incidental to the regulatory function being performed rather than constituting a personnel appointment or portfolio assignment. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters concerning road classification and authority rather than government structure or personnel changes.
